WITH EventCosts AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(ex.cost), 0) AS total_cost
  FROM (SELECT unnest(records) AS e FROM read_json_auto('json/event.json')) AS e
  LEFT JOIN read_csv_auto('csv/budget.csv') AS b
    ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT unnest(records) AS ex FROM read_json_auto('json/expense.json')) AS ex
    ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
  GROUP BY
    e.event_name
)
SELECT
  event_name,
  total_cost
FROM EventCosts
WHERE
  total_cost = (SELECT MIN(total_cost) FROM EventCosts)
ORDER BY
  event_name ASC;
